name: Geri
subtitle: Odin's Wrath
lore: The Hounds of Odin, Geri and Freki, are a pair of fearsome wolves, often found at the All-Father’s side. They feast upon his leavings in Valhalla, and upon the fallen dead of Asgard’s battles. They also now serve as his fist and his wrath throughout Ryven, sent to rend and tear those who have angered their master beyond Asgard’s borders.
